name: CADC — Canadian Adverse Driving Conditions Dataset
description: Pioneering winter-weather autonomous driving benchmark developed by the University of Waterloo WISE Lab. Recorded in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, using an autoware-equipped Lincoln MKZ vehicle fitted with a 32-beam Velodyne VLP-32C LiDAR, 8 synchronized Point Grey cameras, and a NovAtel GNSS/IMU navigation unit. Provides 75 driving sequences with 7,000 3D annotated frames across light, medium, and heavy snowfall conditions, explicitly categorized by snowfall intensity and road coverage.
